_comment: How the voice generator should read text. Numbers, dates, phone numbers and spelled names are handled by tools/spoken.mjs; this file holds the exceptions. 'exact' replaces a whole English sentence; 'replace' swaps a fragment in English text; 'replaceFa' swaps a fragment in Farsi text. The letters of the alphabet are in 'exact' with a full stop after them ("A."), so that each is read as the name of the letter standing alone: the letter A must not sound like the article "a". Some single words are respelled so the voice reads the verb, not the noun or adjective (live = "liv", close = "cloze", use = "yooz"), and so a word said on its own gets its full form (am = "amm", an = "Ann", not the letters M and N). One tap-a-word clip serves every sentence, so "close" in "Is it close?" is also heard as the verb. 'carry' lists whole lines recorded like single words, after "Now say:" (cut out afterwards): one voice drops the "Do" of a question that starts a recording. A few lines are read with a comma instead of a full stop ("I'm sorry, do you have insurance?", "Great, when can you work?", "Yes, I need a tow truck."): after a full stop the voice drops a following "Do", adds a vowel to "Great"/"Hi", or ends "Yes" in a breath that sounds like "Yes, sir".
